IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, August 18, 2026**

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is running hot. Parsons Electric has 88 Inside JW spots across two Polaris Forge Data Center calls in Harwood at **$44.8/hr**, plus **$100/day non-taxed per diem** and **$150 Sat/Sun incentive**, working 6-10's. Grab the ND license bump at **$100/day** extra and you're clearing real money on a build that's moving. Hunt Electric's Grand Forks Air Base call pays the same **$44.8** on 4-10's with 8 hours OT Friday. Book depth is tight—only 140 hands against 27 calls.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** is a high-pay pocket. Microsoft Mount Pleasant is staffing four contractors—Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, Kelso Burnett—all at **$62.51/hr**. That's specialty datacenter money for conduit and finish work. WI inside JW card or reciprocal required; long sleeves and safety toes non-negotiable. 53 Inside JW spots against 11 calls means Book 1 is nearly clear.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** offers the board's top-listed rate: one call from Industrial Electric at Eli Lilly K153 pays **$54.75/hr** on new construction, 6-10's Mon-Sat with extensive background review required. Elmco's Lebanon temp control job and Electric Plus's four-tens round out 30 calls chasing 121 hands—reasonable depth.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is volume play: 48 calls, 309 hands. Whitehead Electric Company and Inglett & Stubbs are cranking feeder pulling and hospital high-rise work at **$40/hr**, with Miller Electrical's cable splicer calls at **$40.9/hr** for medium voltage specialty work. No depth crisis here.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** has Summit Line Project Miner's Santa Teresa job at **$55/hr** with **$1121.00/week per diem** if 350+ miles out—that's long-haul money. Rosendin's Meta campus pays **$40** base plus **$15 incentive** for 90% of a 60-hour week, all OT double time.

Data center and major industrial builds are vacuuming up hands everywhere—but the premium pay is clustering around specialty work (splicers, NETA testing, control systems) and geography (Midwest datacenter builds, Southwest transmission lines).

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, August 18, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and 140 hands needed. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is the anchor, filling 40 Journeyman Lineman slots on distribution work in Columbus with **$125 per diem** nights stayed plus a **$125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s schedule, CDL required. Same contractor's got 9 more JWs headed south for 4-10s distro work. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS needs 6 cable-splicers in Johnstown with **$100/day per diem** and OSHA 10. This is pure volume—nearly half the open board on one local.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is a data-center machine: 27 calls, 140 hands, and Parsons Electric alone is running 88 Inside JW slots at the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood. The rate is **$44.80/hr** with **$100/day non-taxed per diem, $100/day Mon-Fri incentive, $150 Sat/Sun**, plus an additional **$100/day for ND license**. Hunt Electric's got 10 more at the Air Base at the same **$44.80**, 4-10s with 8-hour Friday OT. ND license is real money on this board.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** shows 33 calls on a tight book (110 hands). SERVICE ELECTRIC is the play: 17 JWs at **$46.80/hr, $150/day per diem** on GA Power distro (11 on/3 off); they're also running 10 more at the higher end—**$51.80/hr**—on Georgia Transmission. INCEPTION ENERGY SOLUTIONS has 9 JWs statewide at **$46.80** needing GRID experience, 5-10s M-.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** punches above its 11-call weight. Summit Line's got the headline: 10 Inside JW at **$55/hr** on Project Miner in Santa Teresa, NM, with **$1,121/week per diem** for 350+ miles out, or **$55/hr overscale** within 349 miles. Rosendin's running 44 at **$40** base with **$15 incentive** for 90% of 60/wk, all OT double time.

**LU-194 Shreveport, LA** is small (7 calls, 46 hands) but compact: Caddo and EMS Electric are both running 20+ Inside JW slots on FiberBond work, both at **10% above scale**. That's the signal—fiber deployment is moving cash.

Data-center and fiber work is eating the board. Transmission and distro are steady, but the legs are in Polaris, FiberBond, and MODS nuclear outages.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, August 18, 2026**

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is running hot with 28 calls chasing 46 hands — that's serious board depth. Charter Mechanical's pulling nine High Purity Fitters for Intel Ronler Acres in Hillsboro, plus three Orbital Welders on tool install. Harder's got three BIM Detailer slots and three more Fitters for tool install/demo at the same Intel facility. Ticket work moves fast if you can hang the specs.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** sits at 18 calls needing 61 hands. BCS Mechanical's Sego Project dominates — 15 Journeyman Pipefitters and 13 Journeyman Plumbers, both running 4-10s (6:00 AM–4:30 PM with OT) since Aug 3. Five apprentice slots open too. DSI's QTS data center work in Eagle Mountain is smaller — six JW Pipefitters at **$10.00** on 5-8s shifting to 5-10s + one 8, but that's specialized high-purity piping and the rate reflects it.

**LU-325 Fredericton, NB** has three calls stacked at Irving Oil — two on the Lorneville shutdown (40 and 33 hands needed across PFJ Days), one on the Minor Outage (11 hands, F3/F4 and F6/F5 testing required). Stuart Olson's running the big shutdown crew. These refinery gigs move bodies fast when turnarounds hit.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is tight but solid: eight calls, 27 hands, with **$53.00/hr** showing on Graham's Cenovus Maintenance call (5 Pipefitters, 4-10s spotty OT, 6 AM start). Gem's running a Fab Shop with seven Combo Welders on 6-10s, and three more Pipefitters for the Ineos outage on 5-10s spotty OT. Industrial maintenance is steadier than it looks.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has 10 calls for 43 hands — US Eng. Metalworks needs six SS fitters on night shift in the shop; Murphy's Coors 4-can filler project wants three with Schedule 5 and 10 Stainless chops; Broadcom in Fort Collins is hunting four high-purity tube benders.

Refinery turnarounds and semiconductor fab buildouts are pulling hands east and west simultaneously — whoever can certify on high-purity or stainless is eating.
